study type: Descriptive, monocentric study with prospective recruitment
exposure: Prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV)
outcome: Average length of stay (LOS) after a scheduled caesarean section
cohort: 99 patients who underwent a scheduled caesarean section under neuraxial anaesthesia
finding: Early rehabilitation after caesarean section is feasible in the Algerian context and offers a quick functional recovery with patient satisfaction, as well as a reduction of the length of stay.
